# eastiott

> Shopify storefront repo for **Eastiott** — the quiet-luxury brand selling **The Atelier Tote** (a 3-in-1 everyday tote). Contains a custom Shopify theme built to the brand identity (Cormorant Garamond serif + Jost sans, paper palette, single confident blue, gold accents) plus the design references it was ported from. Organized using the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention.

Connected store: `7rkgkh-kh.myshopify.com` · Plan: Basic · Currency: USD · Owner: loridasam@gmail.com

## Catalog (live in Shopify — do not recreate)

- Product: **The Atelier Tote** — `gid://shopify/Product/8636911943817` (DRAFT, 2 variants: Champagne / Classic Black at $159, 0 inventory, 4 images on CDN)
- Collection: **The Eastiott Collection** — `gid://shopify/Collection/322319679625`
- Customer photos: files named `eastiott-customer-london|plane|couple|street.png`

## Pre-publish flags

- Product is **DRAFT** and **inventory is 0** — set live + stock first.
- Reviews, ratings, "as admired in" press names are **placeholders**. Swap with real data or wire a reviews app before publish (FTC/ASA risk otherwise).
- Bundle tiers + add-ons in the buy box are **presentational only** — they do not modify cart contents.
- Reference HTML shows £/GBP sale prices; theme reads live $/USD price from Shopify.

## Theme

Brand tokens, fonts, header/footer chrome:

- [theme/assets/eastiott.css](theme/assets/eastiott.css): brand tokens, base type, header/footer/announcement CSS, scroll-reveal
- [theme/layout/theme.liquid](theme/layout/theme.liquid): root layout, loads fonts + eastiott.css, renders header/footer sections

PDP composition — `templates/product.json` orders these sections:

- [theme/sections/main-product.liquid](theme/sections/main-product.liquid): gallery + buy box (variants, bundle tiers, add-ons, ATC) — ported from `references/eastiott-tote.html`
- [theme/sections/trust-strip.liquid](theme/sections/trust-strip.liquid): stat strip on slate background
- [theme/sections/editorial-feature.liquid](theme/sections/editorial-feature.liquid): reusable 2-column image + copy block
- [theme/sections/featured-on.liquid](theme/sections/featured-on.liquid): "As admired in" press row
- [theme/sections/features-grid.liquid](theme/sections/features-grid.liquid): four-feature row — ported from `references/eastiott-features-section.html`
- [theme/sections/product-specs.liquid](theme/sections/product-specs.liquid): two-column spec table
- [theme/sections/trusted-by.liquid](theme/sections/trusted-by.liquid): review carousel with gold stars — ported from `references/eastiott-trusted-section.html`
- [theme/sections/rated-grid.liquid](theme/sections/rated-grid.liquid): UGC 4-up grid — ported from `references/eastiott-rated-section.html`
- [theme/sections/faq.liquid](theme/sections/faq.liquid): accordion FAQ
- [theme/sections/newsletter.liquid](theme/sections/newsletter.liquid): email capture (uses Shopify `customer` form)

Chrome sections rendered by layout:

- [theme/sections/announcement-bar.liquid](theme/sections/announcement-bar.liquid)
- [theme/sections/header.liquid](theme/sections/header.liquid)
- [theme/sections/footer.liquid](theme/sections/footer.liquid)

Templates:

- [theme/templates/product.json](theme/templates/product.json): composes the PDP — main → trust-strip → editorial-1 → featured-on → features-grid → editorial-2 → specs → trusted-by → rated-grid → faq → newsletter

Config:

- [theme/config/settings_schema.json](theme/config/settings_schema.json): global theme settings (favicon, accent colour)
- [theme/locales/en.default.json](theme/locales/en.default.json)
